HelloStartupEligibility.heading: Eligibility — you must meet all of these
HelloStartupEligibility.description: To keep this program focused on genuine early-stage businesses, your business qualifies only if it meets every condition below.

cards.title: Registered India business
cards.description: A business entity registered in India — Private Limited, LLP, OPC, Partnership, or registered Proprietorship. Unregistered individuals are not eligible.

cards.title: Revenue below ₹40 lakh
cards.description: Your annual revenue is below ₹40,00,000 (40 lakh), as evidenced by your audited balance sheet.

cards.title: Audited balance sheet
cards.description: A valid audited balance sheet (by a practicing Chartered Accountant) for the most recent financial year, plus proof of registration and a signed self-declaration.

cards.title: One account per business
cards.description: Only one free Startup account per registered entity. Splitting your business to stay within limits will disqualify you.

HelloStartupPlan.heading: What's included in your free plan
HelloStartupPlan.description: The Free Startup Plan gives you full access to Hello — capped at the limits below. Stay within them and you pay nothing.
HelloStartupPlan.action_badge: What you get — and the limits
HelloStartupPlan.notice: Cross any of these caps and you'll simply be invited to upgrade to a paid plan — your account and data continue uninterrupted.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Fill the form and upload your audited balance sheet and registration proof.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our team verifies your documents and eligibility, typically within a few business days.

steps.title: Activation
steps.description: Once approved, your free Startup account is switched on.

steps.title: Annual review
steps.description: We re-confirm eligibility each year and help you transition smoothly as you grow.

HelloStartupGrow.heading: When you grow, you keep everything
HelloStartupGrow.description: Crossing 40 lakh is a good problem. When you do, your data, conversations and setup stay exactly as they are — you just move to a paid Hello plan. No migration, no disruption.

faqs.question: Is it genuinely free?
faqs.answer: Yes — within the usage limits above, for as long as you remain eligible.

faqs.question: Why do you need an audited balance sheet?
faqs.answer: An audited balance sheet by a practicing Chartered Accountant helps us verify revenue objectively and ensure this initiative supports early-stage startups that need it most.

faqs.question: What if I exceed the ticket or agent limit?
faqs.answer: If you cross the limits, you will simply be invited to upgrade to a paid Hello plan. Your account and data will continue completely uninterrupted.

faqs.question: What happens at annual review if I've grown?
faqs.answer: Crossing 40 lakh revenue is great news! We will help you smoothly transition to a regular paid plan with zero migration hassle and no downtime.

faqs.question: Can access be withdrawn?
faqs.answer: Access remains active as long as you remain eligible and adhere to fair use policies. If eligibility terms are violated, access may be revoked after prior notice.
